sentences.en: MIA: Hi, Rob.
sentences.zh: MIA: 嗨，罗布。

sentences.en: How's the course going?
sentences.zh: 课程进展如何？

sentences.en: ROB: Oh, hi, Mia.
sentences.zh: ROB: 哦，嗨，米娅。

sentences.en: Yeah, great.
sentences.zh: 嗯，挺好的。

sentences.en: I can't believe the first term's nearly over.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信第一学期快结束了。

sentences.en: MIA: saw your group's performance last night at the student theatre.
sentences.zh: MIA: 昨晚我在学生剧场看了你们小组的演出。

sentences.en: It was good.
sentences.zh: 演得不错。

sentences.en: ROB: Really?
sentences.zh: ROB: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah but now we have to write a report on the whole thing, an in-depth analysis.
sentences.zh: 是啊，但现在我们必须就整场演出写一份报告，进行深入分析。

sentences.en: I don't know where to start.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该从哪儿下手。

sentences.en: Like, I have to write about the role played, the doctor, how I developed the character.
sentences.zh: 比如，我得写自己所扮演的医生这个角色，以及我是如何塑造这个人物的。

sentences.en: MIA: Well, what was your starting point?
sentences.zh: MIA: 那么，你的起点是什么？

sentences.en: ROB: Er my grandfather was a doctor before he retired, and I just based it on him.
sentences.zh: ROB: 呃，我祖父退休前是一名医生，我就以他为原型来塑造角色。

sentences.en: MIA: OK, but how?
sentences.zh: MIA: 好的，但具体是怎么做的呢？

sentences.en: Did you talk to him about it?
sentences.zh: 你跟他聊过这个吗？

sentences.en: ROB: He must have all sorts of stories, but he never says much about his work, even now.
sentences.zh: ROB: 他肯定有各种各样的故事，但他从来不太讲自己的工作，即使现在也一样。

sentences.en: He has a sort of a authority though.
sentences.zh: 不过他身上确实有种权威感。

sentences.en: MIA: So how did you manage to capture that?
sentences.zh: MIA: 那你是怎么把这种感觉表现出来的呢？

sentences.en: ROB: I'd .
sentences.zh: ROB: 我会……

sentences.en: I'd visualise what he must have been like in the past, when he was sitting in his consulting room listening to his patients.
sentences.zh: 我会想象他过去的样子——比如他坐在诊室里倾听病人诉说时的情景。

sentences.en: MIA: OK, so that's what you explain in your report.
sentences.zh: MIA: 好的，那你在报告中就解释这一点。

sentences.en: ROB: Right.
sentences.zh: ROB: 没错。

sentences.en: MIA: Then there's the issue of atmosphere - so in the first scene we needed to know how boring life was in the doctor's village in the 1950s, so when the curtain went up on the first scene in the waiting room, there was that long silence before anyone spoke.
sentences.zh: MIA: 接下来还有氛围的问题——比如第一场戏中，我们需要让观众感受到1950年代医生所在村庄生活的乏味；因此当幕布在候诊室场景升起时，开场便是一段漫长的沉默，之后才有人开口说话。

sentences.en: And then people kept saying the same thing over and over, like 'Cold, isn't it?'
sentences.zh: 接着人们反复说着同样的话，比如‘真冷，是不是？’

sentences.en: ROB: Yes, and everyone wore grey and brown, and just sat in a row.
sentences.zh: ROB: 对，而且所有人都穿着灰色和棕色的衣服，排成一排坐着。

sentences.en: MIA: Yes, all those details of the production.
sentences.zh: MIA: 是的，所有这些制作细节。

sentences.en: ROB: And I have to analyse how I functioned in the group - what I found out about myself.
sentences.zh: ROB: 我还得分析自己在团队中的作用——以及我对自己有了哪些新的认识。

sentences.en: I know I was so frustrated at times, when we couldn't agree.
sentences.zh: 我知道有时候特别沮丧，因为我们总是无法达成一致。

sentences.en: MIA: Yes.
sentences.zh: MIA: 是啊。

sentences.en: So did one person emerge as the leader?
sentences.zh: 那么，有没有某个人自然而然成了领导者？

sentences.en: ROB: Sophia did.
sentences.zh: ROB: 索菲亚成了领导者。

sentences.en: That was OK she helped us work out exactly what to do, for the production.
sentences.zh: 这没问题，她帮我们明确了整场演出的具体任务。

sentences.en: And that made me feel better, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 我想这让我感觉好多了。

sentences.en: MIA: When you understood what needed doing?
sentences.zh: MIA: 当你弄清楚需要做什么的时候？

sentences.en: ROB: Yes.
sentences.zh: ROB: 对。

sentences.en: And Sophia did some research, too.
sentences.zh: 索菲亚还做了一些调研。

sentences.en: That was useful in developing our approach.
sentences.zh: 这对确立我们的创作思路很有帮助。

sentences.en: MIA: Like what?
sentences.zh: MIA: 比如哪些方面？

sentences.en: ROB: Well, she found these articles from the 1950s about how relationships between children and their parents, or between the public and people like bank managers or the police were shifting.
sentences.zh: ROB: 嗯，她找到了一些1950年代的文章，内容涉及当时儿童与父母之间、公众与银行经理或警察等职业人士之间的关系正在发生的变化。

sentences.en: MIA: Interesting.
sentences.zh: MIA: 很有意思。

sentences.en: And did you have any practical problems to overcome?
sentences.zh: 而且，你们有没有遇到什么实际问题需要克服？

sentences.en: ROB: Well, in the final rehearsal everything was going fine until the last scene - that's where the doctor's first patient appears on stage on his own.
sentences.zh: ROB: 嗯，在最后一次彩排中，一切都很顺利，直到最后一场戏——也就是医生的第一位病人独自登台的那场。

sentences.en: MIA: The one in the wheelchair?
sentences.zh: MIA: 就是坐轮椅的那位？

sentences.en: ROB: Yes, and he had this really long speech, with the stage all dark except for one spotlight and then that stuck somehow so it was shining on the wrong side of the stage ... but anyway we got that fixed, thank goodness.
sentences.zh: ROB: 对，他有一段非常长的台词，舞台全黑，只有一束追光灯打在他身上，但那束灯不知怎么卡住了，结果照到了舞台错误的一侧……不过好在我们及时修好了，谢天谢地。

sentences.en: MIA: Yes, it was fine on the night.
sentences.zh: MIA: 是的，正式演出当晚一切正常。

sentences.en: ROB: But while you're here, Mia, I wanted to ask you about the year abroad option.
sentences.zh: ROB: 不过既然你在这儿，米娅，我想顺便问问你关于海外交流学年这个选项的事。

sentences.en: Would you recommend doing that?
sentences.zh: 你推荐这么做吗？

sentences.en: MIA: Yes, definitely.
sentences.zh: MIA: 是的，绝对推荐。

sentences.en: It's a fantastic chance to study in another country for a year.
sentences.zh: 这是个极佳的机会，能到另一个国家学习一整年。

sentences.en: ROB: I think I'd like to do it, but it looks very competitive - there's only a limited number of places.
sentences.zh: ROB: 我想我挺想去的，但看起来竞争非常激烈——名额十分有限。

sentences.en: MIA: Yes, so next year when you are in the second year of the course, you need to work really hard in all your theatre studies modules.
sentences.zh: MIA: 没错，所以明年你进入课程第二学年时，必须在所有戏剧研究课程模块中都努力取得优异成绩。

sentences.en: Only students with good marks get places - you have to prove that you know your subject really well.
sentences.zh: 只有成绩优秀的学生才能获得名额——你得证明自己对专业内容掌握得非常扎实。

sentences.en: ROB: Right.
sentences.zh: ROB: 明白了。

sentences.en: So how did you choose where to go?
sentences.zh: 那么，你是怎么选择去哪个地方的呢？

sentences.en: MIA: Well, I decided I wanted a programme that would fit in with what I wanted to do after I graduate, so I looked for a university with emphasis on acting.
sentences.zh: MIA: 嗯，我决定选一个与我毕业后职业规划相契合的项目，所以我寻找的是以表演为教学重点的大学。

sentences.en: rather than directing for example.
sentences.zh: 而不是例如以导演为重点的大学。

sentences.en: It depends on you.
sentences.zh: 这取决于你自己。

sentences.en: Then about six months before you go, you have to email the scheme coordinator with Audioscripts your top three choices.
sentences.zh: 然后，在出发前大约六个月，你得通过电子邮件将你的前三志愿提交给该项目协调员。

sentences.en: I had a friend who missed the deadline and didn't 028 get her first choice, so you do need to get a move on at that stage.
sentences.zh: 我有个朋友错过了截止日期，结果没被第一志愿录取，所以到了那个阶段你确实得抓紧时间。

sentences.en: You'll find that certain places are very popular with everyone.
sentences.zh: 你会发现某些目的地对所有人都非常热门。

sentences.en: ROB: And don't you have to write a personal statement at that stage?
sentences.zh: ROB: 这时候是不是还得写一份个人陈述？

sentences.en: MIA: Yes.
sentences.zh: MIA: 是的。

sentences.en: ROB: Right.
sentences.zh: ROB: 明白了。

sentences.en: I'Il get some of the final year students to give me some tips ...
sentences.zh: 我去找几位大四学生请教一些经验……

sentences.en: maybe see if I can read what they wrote.
sentences.zh: 也许还能看看他们当时写了些什么。

sentences.en: MIA: think that's a very good idea.
sentences.zh: MIA: 我觉得这是个非常好的主意。

sentences.en: I don't mind showing you what I did.
sentences.zh: 我不介意把我的个人陈述给你参考。

sentences.en: And while you're abroad don't make the mistake I made.
sentences.zh: 另外，你在国外期间，千万别犯我当初犯过的错误。

sentences.en: I got so involved I forgot all about making arrangements for when I came back here for the final year.
sentences.zh: 我当时太投入了，竟完全忘了为回国读最后一年提前做好安排。

sentences.en: Make sure you stay in touch so they know your choices for the optional modules.
sentences.zh: 务必保持联系，以便校方了解你对选修课程模块的选择。

sentences.en: You don't want to miss out doing your preferred specialisms.
sentences.zh: 可别因此错过自己最想专攻的方向。

sentences.en: ROB: Right.
sentences.zh: ROB: 明白了。
